text:
Rainelle ties for 16th in June scam reports among West Virginia cities
By
N. J. SternRainelle was one of 48 cities tied for 16th in June 2026 scam reports among 63 West Virginia cities with at least one BBB Scam Tracker report, based on one scam report, according to Better Business Bureau.
The city had no scam reports in the previous month.
BBB Scam Tracker lets consumers search reported scams and share their experiences to help others spot similar schemes. The BBB says it reviews each report before publication and does not publicly display the reporter’s name or personal contact information.
Fraud reports have continued to result in large financial losses nationwide. The Federal Trade Commission said consumers reported losing more than $12.5 billion to fraud in 2024, a 25% increase from the previous year.
